title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous research agents are emerging as a promising approach to scientific problem-solving across disciplines, owing to their growing ability to improve a solution through repeated experiments. Evaluating this ability requires benchmarks that pose open-ended research problems and measure improvements over established scientific methods. We introduce REE (Research Entrance Exam), a benchmark that tests AI agents on scientific research. It consists of 100 open-ended research problems spanning five broad scientific areas and 23 domains. To ensure high quality, every problem is drawn from active research in its field and individually reviewed by domain experts. Each problem is posed as a task of iterative improvement: an agent has up to 12 hours to improve a working starter solution, and REE scores the result on a common scale against an established expert solution evaluated under comparable conditions. translated_abstract: 自主研究型智能体正成为跨学科科学问题求解的一种有前景的方法，这得益于其通过反复实验改进解决方案的能力日益增强。评估这种能力需要能够提出开放式研究问题、并衡量其相对于既有科学方法改进程度的基准。我们提出了REE（Research Entrance Exam，研究入学考试），一个测试AI智能体科研能力的基准。它包含100个开放式研究问题，涵盖五大广泛科学领域和23个子领域。为确保高质量，每个问题均取自其领域的活跃研究，并由领域专家逐一审阅。每个问题被设定为一个迭代改进任务：智能体最多有12小时时间来改进一个可运行的初始方案，REE在统一的评分尺度上，将在可比条件下评估的既有专家方案作为对照，对结果进行打分。按照这一衡量标准，四个前沿模型中的两个……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了REE基准——一套包含100个经领域专家审核的开放式科研问题、覆盖五大科学领域23个子领域的考试，用于在12小时迭代改进任务中评估AI智能体相对于既有专家方案的实际科研提升能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces REE, a benchmark of 100 expert-reviewed open-ended research problems across 23 scientific domains that evaluates AI agents' ability to iteratively improve working solutions beyond established expert methods within a 12-hour limit.
